Wemby's Halfcourt Magic

Victor Wembanyama had 33 points, eight rebounds, five assists and three blocks and San Antonio beat Oklahoma City 103-82 in Game 4 on Sunday night to tie the Western Conference finals at 2-2.

https://twitter.com/SportsCenter/status/2058742896787173596

Wemby postgame on whether he makes many halfcourt shots in practice:

https://twitter.com/ClutchPoints/status/2058787322489921701

Victor Wembanyama: 23.3 points, 11.1 rebounds, 3.5 assists per game across 194 career games.

https://twitter.com/statmuse/status/2058740619489489331

Oklahoma City scored 82 points — second-lowest postseason total in franchise history.

After OKC's bench outscored them 76-23 in Game 3, San Antonio came back with what Devin Vassell called "ultra physical" defense. The Thunder shot 33% from the field, 6-for-33 from three.

https://twitter.com/TheNBACentel/status/2058724351336185935

Spurs fans brought an Oscar trophy for SGA. Chanted "FLOPPER" during warmups. Social media roasted him for disappearing when he can't foul bait.

https://twitter.com/HaterReport/status/2058773667476017461

https://twitter.com/TheNBACentel/status/2058713931128902013

The Spurs nuns blessed Luke Kornet pregame. The nuns are 1-0.

https://twitter.com/TheNBACentel/status/2058701982043394308

Game 5 in Oklahoma City on Tuesday. Series tied 2-2.

https://twitter.com/SportsCenter/status/2058742373711073480

Vegas Refuses To Die

Vegas came back from down 3-0 in the first period to beat Colorado 5-3 and take a 3-0 series lead.

https://twitter.com/espn/status/2058744623288213991

First time in Vegas playoff history they've come back from down three goals to win. Colorado had a 74-1 record when leading by at least three goals. Now 74-2.

https://twitter.com/ESPNInsights/status/2058749069439222196

Tomas Hertl scored the go-ahead goal midway through the third. Mark Stone returned from injury and scored 19 seconds into the second period. William Karlsson got his first playoff goal.

https://twitter.com/ESPN/status/2058740000204726279

Nathan MacKinnon blocked a slap shot in the second period, appeared to be hit in the left leg, and took only four shifts in the third with no intensity.

Vegas is 60 minutes from the Stanley Cup Finals. Colorado needs four straight wins. Only the 1945 Red Wings have won an NHL semifinal after losing the first two at home.

https://twitter.com/SportsCenter/status/2058755566642532499

LeBron's Streak Ends

https://twitter.com/ShamsCharania/status/2058690131800838602

LeBron James has 21 All-NBA selections in his career.

https://twitter.com/SportsCenter/status/2058700236017590652

Luka Doncic led the NBA in scoring, made First Team All-NBA, and received zero first-place MVP votes.

Kevin Durant became the 12th player with 12 All-NBA selections.
